newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-ALL-STAR GAME AWARDED TO PHILADELPHIA FOR 1999.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-ALL-STAR GAME AWARDED TO PHILADELPHIA FOR 1999.

text.p: The 1999 NBA All-Star Game will be held at Philadelphia's CoreStates Centre, the league announced on Thursday.

It will mark the third successive year an Eastern Conference team hosts basketball's All-Star showcase. Cleveland hosted in 1997 and the 1998 All-Star Game will be held at New York's Madison Square Garden.
The last All-Star Game in Philadelphia was held at the Spectrum in 1976.
